questions.question: What did God tell Hosea to do in chapter 3?
options: Go again and love an adulterous woman, as God loves Israel
Stop all his prophesying and go serve in the holy temple
Leave the whole land behind and go dwell in the land of Egypt
Divorce his own wife at once and go and marry another
questions.answer: Go again and love an adulterous woman, as God loves Israel

questions.question: What does this act symbolize?
options: The final and complete destruction of the whole northern kingdom
God's enduring love and Israel's eventual return to seek him
The great and terrible famine coming across the whole of the land
The sudden rise of a new and powerful king in the city of Samaria
questions.answer: God's enduring love and Israel's eventual return to seek him

questions.question: Hosea bought back his wife, just as God redeems his people.
Hosea bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a half of _____.
Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God and David their _____.
